# Experiment 11: the cue sheet of the whole video

The cue sheet of experiment 11: the sound effects and the ambience of the whole reference video, a first draft. Times are seconds of the picture. A cue names a recipe of recipes.ts (events of the engine's kinds) or a store entry of experiment 10 (an accepted sound through its effect nodes). The level is in dB under the sound that leads the moment; a stored cue's level is against the accepted hit on the wall, as module-4.json sets it. Dialogue and music are notes only and are not designed. The scenes and the cue times come from a frame sheet at 2 frames a second, a scene-cut detector and the onsets of the reference's audio, measured privately; no sample of the reference is used.

The video lasts 212.6 s. It has 60 scenes, 227 sound events and 56 ambience beds. The engine renders it in 9 segments. The accepted force passage holds 2:16.50 to 2:32.20 (`../10-seven-questions/module-4.json`, variant `slow-many-ordered`). After 3:09.25 the reference has no audio, and the draft is silent too.
